product.title: Private Geology Tour in Rocky Mountain National Park

description.text: Our resident geologist, Ranger Rod, will direct you through Rocky Mountain National Park from the comfort of your own vehicle. He will take photos of your group's adventure as you travel through time in RMNP witnessing evidence of major rock and mineral forming processes that took place billions of years ago. Stops include Trail Ridge Road, Alpine Visitor Center, and Bear Lake. Discover ancient mountains that started rising shortly after the dinosaurs went extinct, as well as landscape formed by later volcanic eruptions. Ideal for travelers basing in Estes Park or the Front Range who want a guided Rocky Mountain National Park outing without self-driving mountain roads.
